pos-hub.service.ts:1454-1459 comment calls B19 'unchanged, and wrong', and :1480 p_delta: isVoid ? qty : -qty on the whole-bottle branch; toast.service.ts glass void branch (~:648-657) books p_delta: qty as a live-stock return, in stock units (bottles).

20261217112500:172-182 ledger row quantity_change = -v_bottles_opened per pour call; 20270301170000:108-117 bottles_out = -sum(quantity_change). So within a window COGS follows bottles opened, not ml poured. It converges over time (a later pour opens no new bottle and books nothing), so the error is period timing and open-bottle remainder, not a permanent loss. margin-to-target.ts:112-121 formula not re-read.
verdicts.corrected_claim: Period cost of goods from the ledger counts bottles opened, so a window that opens a bottle books all of it and a window of pours from an already open bottle books nothing.

verdicts.evidence: pos-hub.service.ts:487-492 returns mode unresolved when ml > capacity, which queues the line for review (not dropped). verdicts.evidence: inventory.service.ts:368-370 fallback key uses Date.now()+random, used only when dto.idempotencyKey is absent; the live web caller InventorySheets.tsx:434 generates a stable key once per sheet (useState(() => freshKey('pour', row.id))), so web retries dedupe.
verdicts.corrected_claim: A caller that omits idempotencyKey gets a non-deterministic key and a retry pours twice; the current web sheet always sends a stable key.
